subject: Breakup: closing the loop on Redwood evaluation
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@orionanalytics.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up + MAP from our discovery call

Hi Alex —

Great talking with you earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our 30-minute discovery: 

- Current priority: evaluating serving options for customer-facing assistants (low-latency + predictable cost)
- Key constraints: PII-sensitive data, must support VPC/private deployment later, pilot target = 3 months
- Stakeholders: you (Platform), Elena Park (CTO), Procurement later for contract

Next steps I suggested on the call (attached):
1) I shared a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones for pilot scope and timeline (mutual-action-plan.xlsx)
2) I'll schedule a technical deep-dive with our solutions engineer — 60min to validate VPC and quantization options
3) We can provide a short hosted demo and sample perf numbers for your representative workload

Can you confirm:
- Is the proposed pilot timeline (kickoff mid-April, pilot complete by end of June) still realistic?
- Who from your team should we include on the technical deep-dive?

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx, redwood-pricing.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

From: Alex Johnson <alex@orionanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@orionanalytics.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + MAP from our discovery call

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and MAP. Elena and I reviewed; the timeline looks OK but we need to align procurement and security. Can you also share a short note on how Redwood handles key management and audit logs? Procurement will want a short security addendum.

I can pull in Procurement next week if we have the high-level answers. For the technical deep-dive, cc'ing Elena — she'll add the right folks.

Alex
Platform Lead, Orion Analytics
alex@orionanalytics.com

Hey Alex —

Wanted to close the loop on our conversation about a pilot. I know priorities shift — if you're still interested, a good next step would be
1) short security summary + answers to your KM/audit questions (I can send today)
2) technical deep-dive with our SE week of Apr 19 (I can confirm availability)

If I don't hear back by Friday, I'll assume this is lower priority and will close the file on our side. Totally open to re-opening when the timing's right — just want to keep our pipeline accurate.

If you'd rather I loop Procurement now, say the word and I'll bring them into the thread and share the security summary.

Thanks for the time so far — appreciate it.
